questions.sentence: If we're trying to figure out who has the most whoa factor, I'm gonna _____ with a big one.
questions.explain: Gonna = going to; first conditional context.

questions.question: Which sentence is a first conditional?
options: If an octopus meets a predator, it will copy another animal.
If an octopus met a predator, it would copy another animal.
If an octopus meets a predator, it copies another animal.
If an octopus will meet a predator, it copies another animal.
questions.explain: First conditional: if + present simple, will + base verb.

questions.sentence: If you touch an octopus, it _____ taste you.

questions.question: Which is the correct first conditional form?
options: If it is attacked, it will change shape.
If it will be attacked, it changes shape.
If it is attacked, it changes shape.
If it was attacked, it will change shape.
questions.explain: If + present simple, will + base verb.

questions.sentence: If a mimic octopus is attacked, it _____ copy the animal that is trying to eat it.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: If a mimic octopus is attacked, it will copy another animal.
If a mimic octopus is attacked, it would copy another animal.
If a mimic octopus will be attacked, it copies another animal.
If a mimic octopus was attacked, it will copy another animal.

questions.sentence: If you get too close to a Giant Pacific Octopus, it _____ vanish in a blink.
questions.explain: Will + base verb for a likely result.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: If you get too close, it will vanish.
If you got too close, it will vanish.
If you get too close, it would vanish.
If you will get too close, it vanishes.
questions.explain: If + present simple (get), will + base verb.
